items.reason: Dornean Gunship is printed Vehicle; Supremacy says "Other friendly Vehicle units get +6/+6."
The Ghost is printed Vehicle; Dorsal Turret says "Attach to a Vehicle unit."
Arena Reek is printed Creature; Always a Bigger Fish says "Defeat a friendly Creature unit."
The Darksaber is an Upgrade that attaches to a non-Vehicle unit; Jango Fett (Ground unit) says "If this unit is upgraded, exhaust an enemy unit."

Governor's Shuttle says "Each player chooses a unit they control. Defeat those units," letting you defeat your own unit on demand; Duchess's Protector says "When Defeated: Create a Mandalorian token."
Pre Vizsla is printed Official; Senator Chuchi says "Give another friendly Official unit Restore 2 for this phase."
Paige Tico is a Pilot (an upgrade, printed Piloting) and Unfettered Ambition says "For each upgrade on attached unit not named Advantage ... give an Advantage token."

FN Trooper Corps says "Give an Experience token to another friendly unit"; Mythosaur says "Friendly upgraded units can't be exhausted or returned to hand by enemy card abilities." The Experience-counts-as-upgrade premise comes from the row reason.
Vernestra Rwoh is printed Force; Ataru Onslaught says "Ready a Force unit with 4 or less power."
Far Far Away says "Return a friendly non-leader unit to its owner's hand"; Rish Loo's "When Played: Take control of an enemy non-leader unit with a Weakness token on it" can be replayed.
Nightsister Lair says "The Force is with you (create your Force token)"; The Son says "While the Force is with you, each friendly unit gets +2/+0."
Dume is printed Force; Ataru Onslaught says "Ready a Force unit with 4 or less power."
Chimaera is printed Vehicle; I Have You Now says "Attack with a Vehicle unit."
Republic Aurek Starfighter is printed Vehicle; Peli Motto says "Give an Experience token to a friendly Vehicle or Droid unit."
Droid Missile Platform is printed Transport; Biggs Darklighter's epic action says "If attached unit is a Transport, it gets +0/+1."

Exploit Confidence says "Return a non-leader unit with 6 or more power to its owner's hand," which can target a friendly unit; Alexsandr Kallus's "When Played: Deal 2 damage to each of up to 3 ground units" can then be replayed.
Vuutun Palaa is printed Vehicle; Rose Tico says "Heal 2 damage from a Vehicle unit that attacked this phase."
Luke Skywalker says "You may exhaust this leader. If you do, heal 1 damage from that unit," which can be Silver Angel; Silver Angel says "When 1 or more damage is healed from this unit."
Vergence Temple says "the Force is with you (create your Force token)"; Dagoyan Master says "You may use the Force (lose your Force token)."

Elzar Mann's tutor makes "an opponent searches twice that many cards ... and draws it," so the draw goes to the opponent. The Mandalorian's "When you draw 1 or more cards" needs you to draw, so Elzar does not offer a draw to its owner.

Han Solo's deployBox says "For each friendly unit or upgrade that has an odd cost, ready a resource," which readies an already-controlled resource and does not add one. Ryyk Blademaster needs "control 6 or more resources," which readying does not reach.

Honor-Bound Partisan says "When Played: Deal 1 damage to a base" (may target an enemy base); Tempest Assault says "If you've dealt damage to an enemy base this phase, deal 2 damage to each enemy space unit."

Jarek Yeager's epic action says "While you control a ground unit and a space unit, attached unit gains Sentinel," and Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle says "Each friendly ground unit with Sentinel gets +0/+2." The buff applies only if the attached Vehicle is a ground unit, which the card allows.

Eviscerator's "When Played/On Attack: Give 2 Advantage tokens to each other friendly unit" is a When Played ability; Qui-Gon Jinn's Aethersprite says "The next time you use a When Played ability this phase, you may use that ability again."
Eye of Sion says "Search the top 8 cards of your deck for a unit ... Play it for free," which puts a unit into play from deck; Eighth Brother says "When you play another unit: You may use the Force."
